findings.message: Multiple root-level HTML files with data-composition-id: index.html, maria.tpl.html. The runtime may discover both as entry points, causing duplicate audio playback.
findings.fixHint: A project should have exactly one root index.html with data-composition-id. Remove or rename extra files.

findings.message: Initial hidden state for "#c02-kpis, #c02-hora" is set via tl.set(...) at position 0 inside the paused timeline. A zero-duration set at 0 does not render while the playhead sits exactly at 0, so frame 0 shows the un-hidden state.
findings.fixHint: Use gsap.set(...) (immediate, outside the timeline) for initial states, or author the hidden state directly in CSS/attributes.

findings.message: GSAP repeat calculation can evaluate to -1 when the composition is shorter than one cycle, which GSAP interprets as an infinite repeat.
findings.fixHint: Clamp the finite repeat count at zero: `repeat: Math.max(0, Math.floor(totalDuration / cycleDuration) - 1)`.
